description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the four archival conditions that must ALL be true simultaneously: 90+ days since last referenced, importance < 0.3, not marked PIN or PERMANENT, and not in episodes/. (2) Apply importance scoring correctly — the 🔥 HIGH marker doubles base weight (0.12 × 2 = 0.24 for entry-009), which is still < 0.3, so entry-009 IS archived despite its HIGH marker. (3) Archive exactly entry-001, entry-004, entry-007, and entry-009 — removing them from MEMORY.md and appending them to memory/archive.md. (4) Preserve entry-002 (📌 PIN), entry-006 (⚠️ PERMANENT), entry-003 (< 90 days), entry-005 (importance 0.35 ≥ 0.3), entry-008 and entry-010 (both reference episodes/ paths). (5) Mark both daily log files (2026-06-14.md and 2026-06-13.md) with the exact comment <!-- consolidated --> without deleting them. (6) Update memory/index.json: set last_consolidated to today's date, set archived_count to at least 5 (1 pre-existing + 4 new), and write a health section with all five metrics (freshness, coverage, coherence, efficiency, reachability) plus an overall score, all as floats in [0,1].
